satz: A reduction in SOL, adjusted for baseline, was seen for melatonin compared with placebo when measured by sleep diaries (-37.49 minutes, 95% CI -55.27 to -19.71 minutes; p<0.0001) and actigraphy (-45.34 minutes, 95% CI -68.75 to -21.93 minutes; p=0.0003).
